Lesson 2 of 2 · Language focus

Describing People

Language drawn from our reading text — A1/A2 — 45–50 minutes — Guided discovery → Confirm → Clarify → Practise → Produce.

Transition

Let's look at the language Sarah used…

From our reading lesson
Sarah: "Well, he's tall with brown hair and green eyes. And he has a beard."
Guided discovery · 5 min

What do the underlined words mean?

In pairs, look at the text again and guess the meaning from context. Don't check a dictionary yet.

He's tall with brown hair and green eyes. And he has a beard.
hair colour?eye colour?face — what is it?
Confirm meaning · 6 min

Matching: describing people

Click a phrase, then click the picture it belongs to. Change your mind by clicking the picture again. When all six are placed, press Check.

Pictures
Phrases
0 / 6 placed

Note: blonde is used for women, blond is used for men.

Clarify · 5 min

Meaning · Form · Pronunciation

Meaning (example)FormPronunciation
has curly hair / has a beardhave/has + adjective + nounhas CURly hair · has a BEARD — stress the noun
is baldis/are + adjectiveBALD — /bɔːld/, long vowel sound
has brown eyeshave/has + adjective + noun (plural)EYES — final /z/ sound, don't drop it
Clarify · 4 min

Two questions that sound the same

They look similar, but they ask for completely different things. Read the two questions, then decide where each word belongs.

What does he look like?

→ his appearance. What you can see.
He's tall with brown hair.

What is he like?

→ his personality. What kind of person he is.
He's friendly and very funny.

Which question does each answer go with?

Clarify · 3 min

Which order?

We put these adjectives in a fixed order in English. Choose the one that sounds right.

The order length or size → style → colour → hair / eyes
long + straight + black + hair  ·  big + green + eyes
Extend · 4 min

Brainstorm

In pairs, list as many more words as you can to describe appearance.

tallshortglasses freckleswavy hairdimples grey hairtattoo + your own…
Controlled practice · 5 min

has, is, or wears?

Choose the right verb for each sentence.

Remember has / has got + hair, eyes, a beard  ·  is / are + tall, short, bald, slim  ·  wears + glasses
Controlled practice · 7 min

What do they look like?

Write one sentence for each person using the target language. Example: Brad has long blond hair.

Freer practice · 8 min

Describe someone you know

Work in pairs. Describe a friend or family member — your partner draws or guesses who it might be. Try to use:

  • has / has got + hair, eyes, a beard…
  • is + tall / short / bald
  • wears glasses

Then: describe someone in this room without saying their name. Can your partner guess who it is?
